title: Retry Backoff: Budgets, Deadlines, and Library Configs
title_es: Retry Backoff: Budgets, Deadlines y Config de Librerías
description: Runnable advanced retry techniques: a Go token-bucket retry budget, a TypeScript hedged request with cancellation, and a Python context-aware retry decorator with a hard deadline.
description_es: Técnicas avanzadas de retry ejecutables: un retry budget con token bucket en Go, un hedged request con cancelación en TypeScript y un decorador de retry context-aware con deadline duro en Python.
